$comment: A push_dpdt whose two poles each switch between 5 V and 3 V into their own RC (22 kohm + 2.2 uF, 47 kohm + 1 uF): the pole contacts are 1 mohm, tau 48 and 47 ms. Position 0, 1, 0 over three 100.5 ms phases swaps which supply feeds which RC at 100.5 ms and 201 ms.

The edits land at 100.5 ms and 201 ms, inside a classic step and not on a sample, so a stepped classic is judged by the comparison's Richardson rule; the core is within W0 of the closed form at every sample (P0-SG verifier V1).
